reason: The hypothesis combines the known problem of Cr–Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr cladding (from P1, P2) with the use of an ultrathin ALD Al2O3 diffusion barrier demonstrated in a completely different material system (Cu–Au, P36, P39). It transfers the barrier concept to a new, extreme nuclear environment and proposes a specific mechanism (physical blocking of Cr and Zr diffusion while preserving Cr2O3 formation) that none of the passages state or suggest for this application.
